name: Akiyama Hiroyuki
source:
A bartender at sótano. He’s a clever and caring young man who always keeps other people’s feelings in mind. 

He’s sociable and good around people. He has a helpful personality and even befriends Haru right off the bat. Naturally, he’s good with women, too; but he’s actually quite shy and old-fashioned, so he doesn’t have any dating experience. He has a frank and stubborn side to him, but that earnestness makes him easily swayed by his surroundings and has caused him a lot of pain. 

”No, I don’t swing that way.” 

[From [url=http://www.mangagamer.com/detail.php?goods_type=1&product_code=131]MangaGamer[/url]]
